What This Actually Is and Why It Matters

The concept of USDT payment gateways might sound like a technical jargon, but it's actually a simple idea: using a cryptocurrency like USDT (Tether) to process payments for your digital products. This approach bypasses traditional payment gateways like Stripe and PayPal, which often reject accounts from regions with high transaction risk. By using a USDT payment gateway, you can accept payments directly from your customers, without relying on a third-party service. This means you get to keep more of your revenue and have full control over your commerce infrastructure. It's a game-changer for digital creators who want to build a sustainable business.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

A USDT payment gateway uses a combination of technologies to facilitate transactions. First, you set up a Cloudflare Pages site to host your digital products, and a Cloudflare Workers script to handle payment processing. When a customer buys a product, the script triggers a payment request to a USDT exchange, which then settles the payment in USDT. The USDT is then automatically converted to your local currency, and deposited into your bank account. This process happens in real-time, without any middlemen or fees. It's a seamless and efficient way to collect payments for your digital products.
